description: This Java class acts as a command handler for loan repayment adjustments within the Fineract platform. It processes commands to adjust loan transactions by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles loan repayment adjustment commands by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the loan adjustment command by invoking the adjustLoanTransaction method of the LoanWritePlatformService.
